title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive
Location: Newark, Nottinghamshire
Salary: £40,000 per annum plus a bonus of approximately £5,000 at target
Working pattern: Office based, with the option to work from home one day per week after probation
Reporting to: Business Development Manager
The role
We are looking for a Business Development Executive to identify, develop and qualify opportunities across new and existing customer accounts. You will combine proactive outreach with the management of inbound enquiries and marketing leads, building your own pipeline while supporting Enterprise Account Managers with theirs.
You will use HubSpot, sales intelligence tools and customer insight to identify the right people to contact, understand their business challenges and arrange meaningful conversations with the sales team. Accurate CRM records and consistent follow-up are central to the role.
What you'll do
- Research target accounts to identify decision-makers, business needs and potential opportunities.
- Run outbound campaigns across prospective, existing, dormant and lapsed customer accounts.
- Respond to and qualify inbound enquiries and marketing-generated leads.
- Build and manage a pipeline in HubSpot, keeping account details, activities, next steps and opportunity stages accurate and up to date.
- Work with Enterprise Sales and Marketing on targeted account campaigns and prospecting plans.
- Arrange discovery meetings, executive briefings, demonstrations, workshops and visits to the Innovation Centre.
- Qualify customer requirements and hand over opportunities to the relevant sales colleague with clear, useful information.
- Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sales intelligence and automation tools to improve the relevance and effectiveness of outreach.
- Track the progress of opportunities and use CRM data to improve conversion rates and follow-up.
- Share customer insight and successful approaches with the wider team.
- Success will be measured through qualified opportunities and meetings, pipeline value, lead conversion, opportunity progression and the quality of your HubSpot records.

What you'll bring
- At least one year's experience in a business development or sales development role.
- Confidence with outbound prospecting and qualifying inbound leads.
- Experience using a CRM to manage a pipeline and maintain accurate customer data; HubSpot experience would be particularly useful.
- Strong research, communication and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive, organised approach to managing multiple accounts and follow-ups.
- The ability to work closely with Sales and Marketing to turn customer interest into qualified opportunities.
- We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences.

If you feel you have the right skills for this role, apply today.

title: Probate Sales Advisor
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking a Probate Sales Advisor to join a growing specialist probate service as part of an award winning law firm in Mansfield, Nottinghamshire. This full-time, permanent job offers a guideline salary of £25,000 to £30,000 depending on experience, hybrid working with one to two days from home each week after completing your initial settling in period. You will benefit from full probate training, a non-contractual bonus scheme and opportunities to progress as the service grows.

Role Responsibilities

As a Probate Client Sales Advisor in Mansfield, you will liaise with clients and help people understand their options following a bereavement, combining sensitive client care with consultative sales. All enquiries are inbound, with no cold calling. Key responsibilities will include:
- Responding promptly to telephone and email enquiries, listening carefully and providing clear, supportive guidance.
- Managing quotations, follow-up activity and outstanding actions, keeping accurate records in HubSpot.
- Learning the Grant Only and Full Administration services while working closely with the client care and probate teams.
- As your knowledge develops, conducting initial consultations to understand the estate and identify the appropriate service.
- Explaining service options and fees clearly, helping clients make informed decisions.
- Managing Grant Only quotations from initial enquiry through to instruction, and qualifying Full Administration enquiries for the closing call.

Person Specification

The successful Probate Sales Advisor will bring a strong record in telephone based, consultative or advisory sales with up to 2 years' experience. You should also be able to demonstrate the following:
- The ability to build trust quickly and handle sensitive conversations with empathy, patience and professionalism.
- Commercial confidence and sound judgement when recommending services appropriate to each client's circumstances.
- Strong organisation and follow up skills, with the ability to manage several active enquiries.
- Experience working towards conversion or revenue targets and confidence using CRM systems.
- Resilience when supporting people experiencing grief or handling emotionally difficult conversations.
- Experience in probate, bereavement services, legal services or supporting vulnerable customers would be beneficial, but is not essential. Full probate training will be provided.

Benefits and Rewards

You will receive structured training and the opportunity to develop within a growing service. Benefits and rewards will include:
- Salary of £25,000 to £30,000 depending on experience, plus a non-contractual bonus scheme.
- Hybrid working with one to two days from home each week after completing an initial settling in period.
- Full probate training and a structured three month training and development period.
- The opportunity to discuss flexible working hours after the initial three-month period, subject to client and business needs.
- Career progression opportunities as the service grows.

About the Law Firm

Our client's specialist probate service is backed by a long established, award-winning law firm in Mansfield, Nottinghamshire. The business places client care, inclusion and employee development at the centre of its approach, with ongoing investment in training and technology. You will join an existing team at an early stage of the service's growth, with the opportunity to contribute to how it develops.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this unique Probate opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Probate Sales Advisor job in Mansfield, Nottinghamshire, please send your CV to Izzie Vaughan at the Eventus Recruitment Group for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

The Eventus Recruitment Group are award-winning recruitment specialists operating in the Legal, Finance and Financial Planning sectors across the UK. Please note, the years' experience and/or salary are listed in our advertisements as a guide. We are happy to consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary to fulfil the role. As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Our privacy policy can be found on the bottom of our website.

title: Recruitment Sales Consultant

description:
Recruitment Sales Consultant

£30,000 basic salary + commission

We re looking for a confident, ambitious and personable Recruitment Sales Consultant to join our established team and play an important part in the continued growth of the business.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include making sales calls to new and existing businesses, identifying potential clients and opportunities, speaking with business owners and decision-makers, arranging and attending face-to-face meetings, developing long-term client relationships and growing our existing client base.

What matters much more to us is your personality, attitude and determination.

You need to be ambitious, resilient and motivated by achieving results.

We re looking for someone who enjoys talking to people, has natural confidence, is commercially minded and genuinely wants to succeed.

In return, we offer a £30,000 basic salary plus commission, with the opportunity to earn more as you develop your client base and achieve results.

If you think you could be the right fit for Fresh Start Recruitment UK Limited, send us your CV and tell us a little about yourself and why this role appeals to you.

title: Telesales Agent
description:
This is an office-based sales role at the centre of the business. You will handle incoming enquiries, work out what the customer actually needs, quote it accurately and convert it into an order. Alongside that you will make outbound calls to existing customers, lapsed accounts and new prospects to grow the order book.

You do not need to have sold pressure gauges, regulators or electrical components before. Full product training is given and there are experienced technical colleagues alongside you. What matters is that you are confident on the telephone, accurate with detail and willing to learn a technical product properly. If you have sold anything with a part number, a specification and a trade customer on the other end of the phone, the skills carry across.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Handle inbound telephone and email enquiries, establishing the application and identifying the correct product, size, pressure range, connection and material.
- Prepare and issue accurate quotations, then follow them through to conversion rather than waiting for the customer to come back.
- Make proactive outbound calls to existing customers, lapsed accounts and new prospects to generate orders and build a pipeline.
- Process orders accurately, confirming specification, quantity, price, lead time and delivery before the order goes through.
- Build working product knowledge across gauges, regulators, air preparation equipment, thermometers, diaphragms and the electrical and electronic lines, so that customers get sound first-line advice.
- Refer complex, bespoke or custom-dial enquiries to technical colleagues, and stay with the enquiry until it is resolved.
- Support distributor and OEM accounts with pricing, availability and lead time information.
- Liaise with purchasing, production and despatch to keep customers informed, particularly where lead times move.
- Handle account queries, returns, repairs and calibration requests from first call through to resolution.
- Maintain accurate customer, contact, quotation and opportunity records on the company system.
- Follow up leads generated by the website, marketing campaigns and exhibitions.
- Record reasons for lost business and feed market and competitor intelligence back to the team.
- Work to agreed call activity, quotation and order intake targets.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Essential
- Experience in telesales, internal sales, sales support, counter sales or another telephone-based sales role. The sector matters far less than the ability.
- Confident on the telephone and comfortable picking it up to make outbound calls as well as answering them.
- Accurate and methodical, with genuine attention to detail on specification, pricing and paperwork. A wrong digit on a part number costs a delivery.
- Willing and able to learn a technical product range, and comfortable asking a question rather than guessing.
